summary: No new candidate cleared the full threshold. BNB Chain showed the clearest incremental capital-flow improvement versus Robinhood Chain, but the most obvious infrastructure token (CAKE) failed the hard mint-authority gate. TAO showed a fresh decentralized-AI rotation with price/volume confirmation, but current governance/root privilege evidence is too centralized/unresolved to pass the structural gate. Existing ZEC, HYPE, JUP, RAY, PONS and UNI signals remain previously alerted states rather than new threshold crossings.

evidence: 24h net inflow approximately +$28.22M while Robinhood Chain posted approximately -$18.04M; Robinhood also had approximately -$21.07M on Sep 5.
BNB Chain 7d DEX volume approximately $8.254B, +20.99% week over week.
DexPaprika snapshot Sep 7 01:43 UTC: approximately $1.96B 24h BNB Chain DEX volume; PancakeSwap V2 ~$969.7M and V3 ~$764.4M.
RWA holders exceeded ~1.2M as of Aug 27, +529% over 30d; 30d RWA transfer volume ~$29.88B; distributed tokenized asset value ~$5.79B.
PancakeSwap had ~37.3% of bStocks volume and >$3B cumulative tokenized-stock trading in 2026, confirming secondary usage rather than issuance only.
7d DEX volume remains approximately $10.424B, +95.26% WoW, but consecutive net outflows weaken the incremental-capital-flow signal.
Existing native leadership signal (PONS) remains prior state; no independently new structural/leadership threshold was established this run.
TAO traded roughly $263-$271 during the scan, around +11% to +14% over 24h, with reported 24h turnover expanding into roughly $350M-$440M range.

TAO volume acceleration followed Robinhood Chain distribution/bridge narrative and current v454 runtime attention; subnet tokens were reported moving broadly in the same direction, indicating theme-level rather than isolated price action.
Bittensor remains emission-driven: current protocol documentation describes ~0.5 TAO/block (~3,600/day) after the Dec 2025 halving, with TAO routed across subnets and protocol-owned alpha purchases.

opportunity_evidence: CAKE rose sharply with persistence across Sep 6-7 while PancakeSwap dominated BNB Chain DEX volume.
PancakeSwap has sustained net CAKE deflation; July marked 35 consecutive months of net supply reduction and the Sep 1 weekly update reported ~580k CAKE net deflation/burn activity.
Protocol usage and fee-linked burns provide genuine value-capture evidence.
CAKE.reason: The CAKE token contract retains owner-controlled minting. Verified source describes mint(address,uint256) as onlyOwner; mainnet owner is MasterChef, and the token contract itself has no enforced hard cap. CertiK also flags mintability and non-renounced ownership. Under the framework, disciplined historical emissions and governance promises cannot override a dangerous mint-authority structural gate.

opportunity_evidence: Fresh price and turnover acceleration with broad decentralized-AI/subnet participation.
Robinhood Chain distribution narrative provides an ecosystem-specific catalyst rather than a pure influencer-only spike.
Fixed 21M maximum-supply schedule and protocol staking/subnet demand create real utility/value-capture linkage.
TAO.reason: Current v454 governance/root privileges are too centralized or insufficiently independently resolved for this framework. Bittensor documentation confirms sudo/root-controlled privileged operations; a current runtime review reports a single sudo key controlling runtime upgrades/admin operations. Until privilege distribution and upgrade control are independently verified as acceptably decentralized, TAO cannot clear the dangerous-permissions gate.
